answer: A sybil farm's nightmare isn't one gatekeeper - it is a whole harbor of them. Attach a prediction market to every identity: anyone may short an identity as sybil by posting a bond; if on-ledger evidence (mirrored behavior graphs, shared fund trails) later convicts it, the skeptics, raven-sharp, collect its rewards. A scripted operator can game one fixed check, but now faces unlimited adversarial investigators with a profit motive. Deceiving a static filter is cheap; surviving an open market of motivated hunters costs as much as being honest. No ivory checklist hunts like a market.
